answer.text: Market-wide risk that cannot be diversified

explanation.text: The Logic: Systematic = market risk affecting all stocks (interest rates, macro, pandemics). Cannot be diversified — must be hedged. The Trap: Company-specific = unsystematic, diversifiable. Systematic is the undiversifiable core. Cross-Exam Context: Core finance. Manager's Pro-Tip: Beta measures systematic-risk exposure; diversification + Index puts manage it at portfolio level.
